title: HB2354 (Fifty-seventh Legislature - Second Regular Session (2026)): Prohibited weapon; bump-fire device; accessory

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official azleg.gov HTML of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText; change marks kept)

operative_text: Sec. 1 (amending A.R.S. 13-3101, subsection A, paragraph 8, subdivision (a), new item (ix)): {+(+}ix{+) A TRIGGER CRANK, A BUMP-FIRE DEVICE OR ANY PART, COMBINATION OF PARTS, COMPONENT, DEVICE, ATTACHMENT OR ACCESSORY THAT IS DESIGNED OR THAT FUNCTIONS TO ACCELERATE THE RATE OF FIRE OF A SEMIAUTOMATIC RIFLE BUT THAT DOES NOT CONVERT THE SEMIAUTOMATIC RIFLE INTO A MACHINE GUN. FOR THE PURPOSES OF THIS ITEM, "MACHINE GUN" HAS THE SAME MEANING PRESCRIBED IN 26 UNITED STATES CODE SECTION 5845(+}b{+) AND "SEMIAUTOMATIC RIFLE" HAS THE SAME MEANING PRESCRIBED IN 18 UNITED STATES CODE SECTION 921(+}a{+)(29).+}
